daily_reference: Equity at 00:00 UTC minus 4% of initial balance; does not trail intraday highs
total_reference: Static floor of 92% of initial balance, including open P&L
funded_exposure_second_breach: failure; separate warning counters per limit
instrument_scope: USDT perpetual futures, including platform-supported tokenized stocks; underlying Alpaca equities are only a price proxy
other_restrictions: No spot, USDC perpetuals, COIN-M futures or options
No martingale recovery sizing, cross-account hedging, external strategy copying or exploitation of simulation errors
Instrument-specific leverage, platform availability, identity and other agreement requirements are not certified by this backtest
legacy_policy: Current rules applied retrospectively for research; older purchased accounts retain applicable legacy terms

research_assumptions.activity_reset_interpretation: Both opening and closing count, a lenient interpretation; report not a certification
research_assumptions.fees_funding_and_perpetual_basis: Not available in Alpaca stock candles; retained as an explicit compliance limitation
